LightningComponentBundle.description: Child records of the record on the page, as a compact linked table.

property.name: parentFieldApiName
property.label: Parent Field API Name
property.description: The child's lookup back to this page's record, e.g. Check__c

property.name: columns
property.label: Columns
property.description: Ordered Label:FieldPath pairs, e.g. Deposit:Name,Amount:Amount__c. Dotted paths are allowed. The first column links to the record.

property.name: linkFieldApiName
property.label: Link Field API Name
property.description: Field holding the id a row opens, when that is not the row itself, e.g. ContentDocumentId. Blank uses the row's own Id.

property.name: linkObjectApiName
property.label: Link Object API Name
property.description: Object the link id belongs to. Blank uses the related object.

property.name: disableRowLinks
property.label: Disable Row Links
property.description: For lists whose rows have nowhere to open, such as a field history.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record Id
property.description: Leave blank to take the record from the page URL.
